verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents a stateless REST API in v1 and v2 with OpenAPI specs, so records can be read and written in both directions. It also documents rate limiting with per-endpoint token costs, and registrable webhooks that POST event notifications for change detection. Nothing in the evidence shows upsert semantics: the person merge endpoint is a different operation. Scale features such as bulk or batch endpoints and incremental-sync cursors are also unevidenced. missing for 10: documented upsert/idempotent create-or-update, bulk/batch endpoints for at-scale sync, concrete rate-limit figures and backoff guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of sync at scale.
